baseline_models.mechanism: The opening summons eye and insight to read benefit across disclosed and interior layers; the paired adjectives turn seeing into an evidentiary task rather than a glance.

activation_trace.role: Eye-and-insight perception supplies the observing act and makes it evidentiary.
Emergence and disclosure supply the outward layer of benefit.
A hidden inward reality supplies the concealed layer that reflection must infer.

changed_reading.before: The question merely points to obvious blessings.
changed_reading.after: The question demands perception across both manifest effects and concealed interiors, making incomplete seeing part of the verse's problem.

baseline_models.mechanism: Subjection directs diverse creation toward a human-serving end, while completion and covering make blessing an encompassing habitat rather than a list of possessions.

activation_trace.role: Taming and driving toward a purpose supply coordinated service rather than inert availability.
Completion and full measure make the benefit system comprehensive.
Length and breadth until covering supply the enveloping geometry of blessing upon the recipients.
Good condition and favor name the resulting lived state, not merely its component goods.

changed_reading.before: Heavenly and earthly things are simply available for human use.
changed_reading.after: A coordinated creation is directed into a complete, covering field of benefit within which human life operates.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُجَادِلُ ... بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَابٍ مُنِيرٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: Disputation can be tightly twisted and formally forceful while lacking three distinct bearings: disclosed recognition, directional guidance, and a joined, illuminating record.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting supplies the image of an argument whose strands can look internally coherent.
Entangled contest supplies the social action of adversarial disputing.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the missing recognitional ground.
Gentle direction to a path supplies the missing orientation.
An inscription that establishes obligation supplies the missing accountable standard.
Light and illumination supply the missing capacity to make the standard publicly legible.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns argument caused by generic ignorance.
changed_reading.after: It exposes a possibly well-braided argument that has no disclosed ground, no route, and no illuminating standard by which its force can be tested.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening presents the wise book as guidance and mercy, so the focus triad is an inversion of already supplied means rather than a neutral inventory of absent credentials.

activation_trace.role: Direction toward the path anchors the focus verse's explicitly missing guidance.
Illumination anchors the focus demand that a cited book actually clarify.
Joined letters and a written object supply the concrete book announced before the dispute.
Gentle path-direction identifies that announced book's operative function.

structural_cues: 31:2-5 sequence book, guidance, mercy, practice, and success before 31:20 negates guidance and illuminating book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the opening book-guidance sequence and the focus negations; I infer availability followed by refusal or detachment. Alternatively, the recurrence may only classify sound and unsound speakers without implying deliberate refusal.

changed_reading.before: The disputant happens not to possess adequate sources.
changed_reading.after: The disputant speaks outside a guidance system the surah has already placed in view, making the deficit relational as well as informational.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirrored person in 31:6 acquires distracting discourse, diverts from a path, and converts signs into mockery; this recasts focus disputation as participation in an economy of attention rather than an isolated intellectual error.

activation_trace.role: Entangled contest anchors the focus action that the earlier discourse economy helps explain.
Commercial exchange supplies acquisition and circulation as the social mechanism.
Being occupied by one thing away from another supplies attention capture.
Deviation from guidance and purpose supplies the effect of the captured attention.
A traversable extended path supplies what the distracting discourse diverts people from.
Ridicule supplies the terminal social posture of the diversion.

structural_cues: 31:6 and 31:20 repeat وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن and بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ; 31:7 then stages proud turning and simulated deafness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated human type plus exchange, distraction, deviation, and mockery; I infer a causal chain from attention capture to disputation. Alternatively, 31:6 and 31:20 may portray separate offenders whose shared syntax only marks a class.

changed_reading.before: A person spontaneously argues from ignorance.
changed_reading.after: The argument can be the downstream product of purchased, circulating distraction that first displaces the path and then rewards ridicule.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible cosmic order is paired with support, stabilization, and prevented oscillation, then with a demand to show rival creation; outward blessing becomes the readable result of operations not themselves foregrounded.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure anchors the visible outcome side of the focus pair.
Hidden interiority anchors the unexposed operative side of the focus pair.
Support by a prop supplies the question of what holds an ordered expanse up.
Firm settling supplies the stabilizing operation visible through its effects.
Oscillation and tilting supply the movement that stabilization prevents.
Making something visible supplies the evidentiary challenge to display an alternative creation.

structural_cues: 31:10 juxtaposes the seen heavens with support language, fixed mountains, and prevented swaying; 31:11 answers with an imperative to show.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies support, stabilization, prevented motion, and showing; I infer an unseen-operation to visible-habitability arrow. The live alternative is that 31:10 denies pillars altogether rather than positing invisible pillars, so the model rests on hidden operations generally, not hidden columns specifically.

changed_reading.before: Visible and hidden blessings are two static categories.
changed_reading.after: The visible world can be read as the output layer of concealed stabilizing operations, and seeing properly means tracing effect back toward support.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to thank is grounded in pregnancy, repeated weakness, and eventual weaning; blessing's hidden layer becomes bodily labor and depletion concealed beneath the recipient's visible life.

activation_trace.role: Favor and good condition anchor the life received as blessing.
The inside of a thing anchors gestation as a literal hidden site of benefit.
Interior pregnancy and fruit supply the concealed carrying process.
Loss of strength supplies the cost borne twice over beneath the resulting life.
A child separated from nursing supplies the temporal endpoint of dependent nourishment.
Recognition of favor and praise of the giver supplies the required response to hidden labor.

structural_cues: 31:12 introduces gratitude; 31:14 directs gratitude to God and parents after a two-year bodily sequence; 31:15 limits obedience without canceling good companionship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed carrying, cumulative weakness, weaning, and gratitude; I infer that hidden blessing includes another person's unobserved cost. Alternatively, the parental unit may exemplify obligation without defining the focus pair's full scope.

changed_reading.before: Inward blessings are private spiritual states or imperceptible divine gifts.
changed_reading.after: They also include embodied and relational costs hidden inside the visible life a beneficiary receives, so gratitude must look behind the finished benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: A mustard-weight hidden in rock or the cosmic domains remains retrievable because minuteness and concealment are matched by subtle access and knowledge of interiors; hiddenness therefore does not entail moral loss.

activation_trace.role: Concealed inward reality anchors the focus category being made dynamic.
Disclosure to a knower anchors the contrast between divine retrieval and unsupported dispute.
Measured weight supplies exact accountability at minute scale.
The mustard seed supplies the materially tiny trace.
Massive hard rock supplies maximal enclosure around the tiny trace.
Smallness, fineness, and hiddenness supply access at the trace's own scale.
Knowledge of an affair's interior supplies retrieval despite enclosure.

structural_cues: 31:16 moves one minute item through rock, heavens, and earth, then says God brings it forth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact weight, tiny seed, enclosure, subtlety, and interior knowledge; I infer concealment to retrieval to accountability. Alternatively, the example may concern divine omniscience broadly rather than specifically revising the focus blessings.

changed_reading.before: The inward is a static class of unseen benefit.
changed_reading.after: The inward is also a scale and location from which even the smallest consequential trace can be brought into disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cheek, gait, and voice are visible surfaces on which excessive inward self-estimation becomes legible; the focus pair can therefore diagnose congruence or leakage between inner posture and public conduct.

activation_trace.role: Public emergence anchors the outward behavioral surface.
Hidden inward reality anchors the posture disclosed through that surface.
Tilting cheek and neck away in pride supplies a facial disclosure of inner rank-making.
Joy exceeding its measure supplies the affect driving conspicuous movement.
Swagger in walking supplies the bodily performance of inward conceit.
Audible voice supplies another outward channel through which inward measure is tested.

structural_cues: 31:18-19 move from face to walking to vocal volume, making inward excess progressively observable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pride-marked face, gait, and sound; I infer inner posture to outer signal. Alternatively, these may remain discrete etiquette commands rather than a general account of visible and hidden blessing.

changed_reading.before: Outward and inward name separate gifts.
changed_reading.after: They can also name coupled dimensions of a person: inward orientation becomes inspectable in the use of outwardly bestowed body, movement, and voice.

context_deltas.mechanism: When revelation is proposed, inherited discovery and parental precedent become a substitute route; lack of guidance or illuminating book can thus coexist with confident participation in a socially transmitted path.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction to the true path anchors the missing criterion in the focus.
Binding inscription anchors the absent authority against which inherited practice could be tested.
Following behind supplies the mechanism of adopting a route from predecessors.
Finding something already present supplies inherited availability as its own warrant.
Fatherhood and upbringing supply the social channel through which the substitute path gains authority.

structural_cues: 31:21 directly contrasts following what God sent down with following what was found upon the fathers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two competing objects of following and an inherited chain; I infer social transmission as a replacement epistemology behind focus disputation. Alternatively, the focus disputant need not be identical with the ancestral followers.

changed_reading.before: No guidance or book means the disputant has no framework.
changed_reading.after: The disputant may have a powerful inherited framework, but it is a substitute route untested by the guidance and illuminating standard named in the focus.

context_deltas.mechanism: The alternative to verbal entanglement is staged bodily: hand over the face or orientation, act well, grasp, and settle trust in what is firm. Guidance becomes enacted alignment and reliable attachment.

activation_trace.role: Direction and intended course anchor guidance as orientation rather than information alone.
Tight twisting anchors the verbal entanglement answered by a firm attachment.
Handing over and releasing a thing supplies surrendered agency.
Direction and orientation supply what is surrendered and aligned.
Holding and retaining supply active attachment rather than passive assent.
Trust and repose in a support supply the reliability of the grasped orientation.

structural_cues: 31:22 sequences surrendered face, beneficent action, the branchless ع ر و handhold construction, firmness, and final outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies orientation, surrender, grasp, and trust; I infer a bodily counter-mechanism to disputation. Alternatively, the handhold may summarize fidelity without mapping each focus epistemic term onto a bodily operation.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is mainly correct content missing from an argument.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is also an embodied orientation one entrusts, performs, and holds, contrasting with argument that only tightens around itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers can correctly name God as creator of heavens and earth and still be classified as not knowing; knowledge in the focus is therefore integrated recognition with consequences, not possession of one correct proposition.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower anchors the disputed meaning of knowledge in the focus.
Reflection and considered judgment anchor the integration demanded beyond bare sight.
Disclosure to a knower is explicitly denied after the correct creator-confession, separating answer from integrated recognition.

structural_cues: 31:25 asks who created the same heavens and earth named in 31:20, records the answer Allah, then says most do not know.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a correct answer followed by denied knowledge; I infer proposition without integration. Alternatively, 'most do not know' could target further facts or consequences not the status of their stated answer itself.

changed_reading.before: The disputant lacks the proposition that God created the cosmos.
changed_reading.after: The disputant may confess that proposition yet fail to let it organize gratitude, allegiance, and argument, which is the deeper absence of knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pens and repeatedly supplied seas cannot exhaust divine words; the illuminating book becomes a finite, usable aperture into an inexhaustible semantic source, not a claim that revelation contains divine reality by exhaustion.

activation_trace.role: Joined letters and writing anchor the bounded textual medium in the focus.
Illumination anchors the medium's clarifying function rather than exhaustive capacity.
A prepared writing reed supplies the finite inscription instrument.
Vast abundant water supplies an immense writing reservoir.
Ink that keeps supplying a pen turns the reservoir into continued inscription.
Exhaustion and ending supply the limit explicitly denied of the words.
Meaningful expressions supply what remains inexhaustible despite every material writing aid.

structural_cues: 31:27 repeatedly enlarges writing material and then denies that divine words reach an endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies finite pens, multiplied ink, and inexhaustible words; I infer book as a clarifying interface rather than exhaustive container. Alternatively, the plenitude image may praise divine speech without qualifying the function of the focus book.

changed_reading.before: An illuminating book is a complete store of propositions used to end dispute.
changed_reading.after: It is a bounded but genuinely clarifying interface that orients readers within divine meaning precisely without exhausting that meaning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night enters day and day enters night while subjected luminaries run to a fixed term; cosmic service is a dynamic, timed circulation in which concealment and disclosure continually exchange places.

activation_trace.role: Directed taming anchors the focus claim that creation serves an ordered purpose.
Emergence anchors the disclosed phase of the alternating cycle.
Concealment anchors the hidden phase of the alternating cycle.
One thing entering inside another supplies reciprocal temporal interpenetration.
Directed subjection makes sun and moon moving instances of the focus system.
Flowing motion supplies continuous operation rather than static availability.
A fixed temporal limit supplies bounded duration and schedule.

structural_cues: 31:29 repeats the focus opening أَلَمْ تَرَ and its subjection claim, then renders both as alternating and time-bounded processes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal entry, moving luminaries, and a term; I infer concealment to disclosure as a service cycle. Alternatively, night and day may exemplify subjection without redefining the focus's outward and inward blessings.

changed_reading.before: Subjection is a static inventory of useful cosmic objects.
changed_reading.after: Subjection is scheduled process: useful order arises from continuous motion, alternating visibility, and limits that no beneficiary controls.

context_deltas.mechanism: Blessing carries the ship visibly, but an overhead wave covers the passengers and strips allegiance to an exclusive interior; rescue then discloses divided constancy, denial, and betrayal. Benefit and danger together stress-test what was hidden.

activation_trace.role: Favor and good condition anchor the blessing whose operation is tested at sea.
Hidden inward reality anchors the allegiance exposed under pressure.
A vessel moving in water supplies the material carrier of visible benefit.
Favor explicitly supplies the enabling condition of the vessel's passage.
An overlying cover supplies crisis as sudden occlusion of the ordinary visible world.
Intermixed turbulence supplies destabilizing pressure around the passengers.
Exclusive separation from association supplies the interior allegiance crisis brings to the surface.
Obedience and yielding identify that exposed allegiance as enacted commitment.
Denial despite knowledge supplies post-rescue suppression of what crisis disclosed.
Betrayal and failure to fulfill supply the reversal after deliverance.

structural_cues: 31:31 repeats أَلَمْ تَرَ and blessing; 31:32 moves from covering wave to exclusive appeal to rescue to mixed response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enabled travel, totalizing danger, exclusive devotion, rescue, denial, and betrayal; I infer crisis reveals an interior that safety can conceal again. Alternatively, the sequence may contrast situational behaviors without claiming a stable hidden self.

changed_reading.before: Outward and inward blessings are benefits received in two domains.
changed_reading.after: Blessing is also an exposure device: its interruption and restoration reveal whether inward allegiance corresponds to the visible claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final inventory places hour, rain, wombs, tomorrow's acquisition, and place of death beyond ordinary self-knowledge; the focus summons reading of hidden blessing without licensing total penetration of the hidden.

activation_trace.role: Eye-and-insight perception anchors the focus invitation whose reach is being bounded.
Hidden inward reality anchors the domain that cannot all be opened by human reflection.
Disclosure to a knower anchors the epistemic standard denied of unsupported dispute.
Presence with and proximity assign the listed knowledge to God.
Disclosure to a knower frames the inventory as asymmetrically known.
Life-giving rain from the sky supplies a blessing whose timing and descent remain controlled knowledge.
Practical knowing is twice denied to the self regarding tomorrow and death-place.
Seeking and obtaining benefit supply the unknowable content of tomorrow.
Loss of life supplies the unknowable terminal event and location.

structural_cues: 31:34 closes with repeated وَمَا تَدْرِى نَفْسٌ and pairs divine knowledge with human uncertainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a final asymmetry between divine and human knowing; I infer a boundary on the baseline's two-layer seeing. Alternatively, the list may concern future particulars only and leave broad inference about hidden blessings unrestricted.

changed_reading.before: Proper reflection can in principle uncover both outward and inward blessing.
changed_reading.after: Reflection can recognize hidden dependence and effects, but some interiors and futures remain irreducibly God's knowledge; the verse opposes groundless certainty as much as inattentiveness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The unpaid-labor sense is surprising because the focus form conventionally describes divine ordering, yet it remains anchored in the supplied branch for سخر and exposes the moral friction inside 'for you.' Render it only as an ethical resonance about entitlement, never as a replacement gloss or a claim that the verse condemns cosmic use.

activation_trace.role: A worker compelled without wages supplies an exploratory social shadow to creation's service 'for you.'

changed_reading.before: Cosmic service grants uncomplicated entitlement to use.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, gifted service warns beneficiaries not to reproduce gratitude-less conscription in their own relations.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Turning an affair from back to belly is surprising because it is an idiomatic branch rather than the direct adjective sense, but the focus places the same two roots side by side after a command to perceive. Render it as an interpretive procedure, not as a lexical translation of ظاهرة وباطنة.

activation_trace.role: Deliberation and reflection supply the operation of inspecting more than a first surface.
Turning an affair from back to belly supplies a reversible inspection procedure.
The hidden interior supplies the side reached when the apparent benefit is turned over.

changed_reading.before: Outward and inward are two bins of blessings.
changed_reading.after: They can cue a method: turn each apparent benefit over, inspect its concealed dependencies and costs, then return to the visible whole with a changed judgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The mark and aperture images come from form-distant split mappings of the focus sky root, so treating them as direct senses would be unsound. They remain worth carrying as a packet-authorized material analogy: qualify the heavens as 'as though' a marked, permeable interface through which hidden provision becomes visible.

activation_trace.role: A visible mark from which condition is inferred supplies the sky as a readable sign-surface.
A narrow aperture through which something enters supplies permeability between hidden source and visible benefit.
Abundant water that wets through supplies material transmission from interface to recipient.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are only the upper container of subjected things.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, they become a marked and permeable interface where hidden provision leaves visible effects and passes into lived blessing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The intergroup-conflict branch of نور is surprising and form-distant from مُنِير, but its adjacency to entangled disputation gives it a traceable social mechanism. Render it only as a secondary contrast: illumination can prevent argumentative heat from becoming communal fire; do not gloss مُنِير as conflict.

activation_trace.role: Entangled contest supplies the argumentative heat requiring containment.
A blaze of conflict between groups supplies the social failure that absent illumination may permit.
Joining one thing to another supplies a shared textual medium capable of holding disputants to common relations.

changed_reading.before: The illuminating book only supplies private intellectual clarity.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, its illumination also functions publicly by keeping braided disagreement from igniting into a social blaze.

strongest_changes: The 31:6 syntactic mirror turns unsupported disputation into the downstream product of an attention market that buys distraction, leaves the path, and rewards ridicule.
Maternal carrying and the mustard-seed scene make the outward/inward pair concrete as concealed cost and minute retrievable consequence, not merely visible versus spiritual gifts.
Night/day and the sea sequence turn subjection from static inventory into timed process and turn blessing into a crisis test that exposes interior allegiance.
The final knowledge inventory bounds the opening invitation to see: hidden dependence can be recognized without claiming access to every hidden future.
summary.what_was_special: The focus pair ظاهرة وباطنة kept changing domain without losing its anchor: cosmic mechanics, maternal embodiment, moral scale, bodily conduct, temporal alternation, and crisis disclosure. Meanwhile علم, هدى, and كتاب منير remained distinct tests rather than collapsing into generic evidence.
remaining_uncertainties: 31:10 may deny pillars altogether rather than imply unseen pillars, so hidden support is retained at the level of operation, not invisible columns.
The repeated وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن may link one rhetorical type across 31:6 and 31:20 or may only juxtapose separate examples.
The split-root and distant-branch outliers are useful material analogies but should not be promoted into direct lexical glosses.
